flipToBack.timing: Required singleton trigger on isTableChanged (standing state)
flipToBack.prose: Flips when Luke or a Jedi is at a battleground site, UNLESS an opponent's character of ability > 4 is at (any) battleground site.

children.req: presence (card-at-location): Luke or a Jedi at a battleground site
blocker presence: opponent character of ability > 4 at a battleground site
children.gameConditions: GameConditions.canSpot(game, self, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.and(Filters.opponents(self), Filters.character, Filters.abilityMoreThan(4), Filters.at(Filters.battleground_site)))

flipToFront.timing: Required singleton trigger on isTableChanged (standing state), suppressed permanently if Vader has crossed over
flipToFront.prose: Flips back (unless Vader crossed over) if an opponent character of ability > 4 is at a battleground site OR you no longer have Luke or a Jedi at a battleground site.

children.req: chosen-state exception: Vader crossed over (suppresses flip-back for rest of game)
blocker presence: opponent character of ability > 4 at a battleground site
children.gameConditions: GameConditions.canSpot(game, self, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE, Filters.and(Filters.opponents(self), Filters.character, Filters.abilityMoreThan(4), Filters.at(Filters.battleground_site)))

children.req: presence: Luke or a Jedi at a battleground site

requirementSemantics: Flip both ways is PRESENCE (card-at-location canSpot) semantics, never control/occupy: 'Luke or a Jedi AT a battleground site' and 'opponent ability>4 character AT a battleground site'. The two sides' battleground sites need not be the same site.
The opponent blocker is global: ANY opponent character of ability > 4 at ANY battleground site blocks the flip forward and forces the flip back.
Back flip-back has a persona-state exception: once Vader is crossed over (isCrossedOver(Persona.VADER)), the back never flips back regardless of board state.

The canSpot filters are NOT owner-restricted on the Luke/Jedi leg (Filters.or(Filters.Luke, Filters.Jedi) without Filters.your) - any spottable Luke/Jedi at a battleground site satisfies it; the blocker leg IS opponent-restricted via Filters.opponents(self).
typedIdentities: Filters.and(Filters.or(Icon.EPISODE_I, Icon.EPISODE_VII), Filters.or(Filters.and(Filters.character, Filters.except(Filters.or(Filters.ObiWan, Filters.Yoda))), Filters.and(Filters.location, Filters.except(Filters.Lars_Moisture_Farm))))
setupAndPullRoutes: Start of game deploys Anakin's Funeral Pyre (with Prophecy Of The Force deployed onto it), Ewok Village, and I Feel The Conflict from Reserve Deck (front:52-83).

No reserve-deck pulls/tutors coded on either side. Back card-flow engines instead: once per control phase peek at top X of Reserve Deck (X = battlegrounds you occupy, uses Filters.occupies(playerId)), take one into hand, shuffle (BACK:60-90); once per draw phase retrieve ANY one card, but opponent may stack a hand card face-down on I Feel The Conflict to place the retrieved card out of play instead (BACK:92-141).
otherObligations: Front, remainder of game: may not deploy [Episode I] or [Episode VII] characters or locations except Obi-Wan, Yoda, and Lars' Moisture Farm (front:86-90).
Front, remainder of game: Emperor's Power does not increase deploy costs at battlegrounds (ImmuneToDeployCostModifiersToLocationModifier, front:91-93).
Front, while this side up: you may initiate battles for free (MayInitiateBattlesForFreeModifier, front:98-103).
Both sides: if Luke just won a battle, may re-circulate and shuffle Reserve Deck (optional trigger, front:106-121; BACK:146-161).

Strategic note from law: to flip AND stay flipped, keep Luke/a Jedi parked at a battleground site and either kill/avoid opponent ability>4 characters at battleground sites or achieve Vader crossover to lock the back permanently.

profileGaps: keyCharacterFilter is null; the flip actor is Filters.or(Filters.Luke, Filters.Jedi) at a battleground site.
No representation of the global blocker (opponent character of ability > 4 at any battleground site blocks flip and triggers flip-back) - the single most important tactical fact for this objective.
No representation of the Vader-crossed-over exception that permanently locks the back side.

flipGateSite null is acceptable (gate is 'any battleground site'), but no profile field encodes that abstraction either; requiredCardsOnTable empty despite I Feel The Conflict being both a setup card and the opponent's counter-tool against the back's retrieval.
